## What this changes

SIG-STORE-045 declares the shipped DDL generated from LinkML and the generated
artifact authoritative — while the repo has always run the other posture: the
`deployed` physical schema is authored sqitch (`db/sqitch.plan` +
`db/deploy|revert|verify`, SIG-STORE-041) and the generated
`ontology/generated/sql/sig.sql` (`SQLTableGenerator` logical DDL) is neither
`deployed` nor compared — nothing under `db/` references it. Open BL-049
recorded the gap as owed while accepted BL-050/LD-D01 recorded the same
posture as sanctioned — F3 NEW-10's contradiction. GATE-P routed it here as a
ticket; the catalog's preferred close lands:

- **`docs/adr/ADR-248` — sqitch DDL is the authoritative physical schema; the
  generated `sig.sql` is documentation only.** `db/sqitch.plan` is the sole
  physical authority (the spine's DDL carries machinery generated logical DDL
  cannot express — append-only triggers, tier RLS, the non-overlap exclusion,
  roles/column-scoped grants); `sig.sql` is a §20.1 downstream form kept
  fresh by the generation gate. SIG-STORE-045's clause is qualified, not
  erased: the ontology stays the *logical* authority (ADR-007) and
  divergence-is-a-defect reconciliation stands. Alternatives recorded —
  a byte-level conformance test (no sound mapping exists to assert), the
  LD-D01 waiver (rejected by the GATE-P route), generate-to-`deploy`
  (cannot express the machinery; makes the generator a `deploy` tool).
- **`ontology/src/ontology/generate.py` + regenerated
  `ontology/generated/sql/sig.sql`** — a generator-written `GENERATED
  DOCUMENTATION` header makes the artifact self-declare the posture wherever
  it is read (generated bytes, never hand-edited; the diff is the 4-line
  header only).
- **`tests/unit/test_schema_conformance.py` (+5)** — the guard that fails
  loud if the posture silently shifts: the declared header is present; no
  `deploy`-capable surface (`db/`, `scripts/`, ops shells/toml, workflows,
  `Makefile`, containers) references the generated DDL; every `sqitch.plan`
  change resolves to its deploy/revert/verify scripts; the generated surface
  carries no physical machinery; the ADR record names the rule.
- **Records** — ADR index regen; `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` row (quiet at authoring,
  home BL-087); BL-087 sources + desc mention; Appendix F row via `spec_src`
  + `BUILD.sh` (check_spec_src byte-identical); `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv`
  SIG-STORE-045 → `covered+tested` / `MET-DIFFERENTLY(ADR-248)`; BL-049 →
  closed and the BL-050 reconciling note land in closeout with the PR
  number; projection regen fresh (1280/1280).
